name: Galaxy
description: If you gaze into this paint long enough, you can see a cat flying through space on a slice of pizza.
interestingFacts: This paint was available in the Shop as part of a special package during the Cosmonautics Day 2018 celebrations from 13 to 16 April 2018.
Other than Monochrome (sometimes), this is the darkest-colored paint in the game.
The paint was offered in a special bundle with 20 energy, 10 ultra containers, and 10 coinboxes for 1690 tankoins from April 12-30, 2021.
